subject: [hw] V10 implemented/UNDEF A32 mnemonic list for the census
body:
V10 here (A32 data processing, moves, multiplies; emu/n2a32_arm_dp.c, host-tested: N2TEST V10 PASS 220539/220539). For your A32 census, this is exactly what I implement and what I deliberately return N2A32_UNDEF for. Please flag any use of an UNDEF item in bin/vpud, libvpud_vcodec.so, libvcodecdrv.so, libvcodec_utility.so, libvcodec_oal.so (address + mnemonic) and I will implement it.

IMPLEMENTED (A32, cond != 0xF): AND EOR SUB RSB ADD ADC SBC RSC TST TEQ CMP CMN ORR MOV BIC MVN, each with immediate (ARMExpandImm_C), register with LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR/RRX immediate shift, register with register-specified shift, S variants; MOVW, MOVT; MUL MLA MLS UMULL UMLAL SMULL SMLAL UMAAL (S variants where they exist); MRS Rd,CPSR; MSR APSR_nzcvq / APSR_g / APSR_nzcvqg, Rm; CLZ; ADR (ADD/SUB with r15); ALU writes to r15 (branch via BX semantics).

DELIBERATELY UNDEF (full table in emu/test_v10/STATUS.md): MRS Rd,SPSR and MSR SPSR_* (no SPSR in User mode); MSR with control/x masks (e.g. msr cpsr_fsxc) and MSR (immediate); data processing with S=1 and Rd=15 (ALUExceptionReturn, privileged); MOVW/MOVT Rd=r15; r15 as MUL/MLA/MLS/UMULL/... operand; MRS/MSR/CLZ with r15; cond=0xF (unconditional space); and everything outside the class: BX/BLX, hints (NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/DBG), all loads/stores, QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB, SMULxy/SMLAxy, SDIV/UDIV, extend/bitfield/saturate/parallel/media, coprocessor, SVC/BKPT/UDF.

Note on MRS for the census: my A32 MRS returns APSR(N,Z,C,V,Q,GE) | 0x1D0 (A|I|F read as 1 in User mode, E=0) | T from c->thumb | IT bits from c->itstate. If the census shows MRS in A32 code, that is the value the guest sees.
